window.rule: visible public publication or update time strictly within the preceding seven days

selection.method: previously unchecked leaves first, then oldest last_checked_at, stable relative-path tie-break

qualifying_updates.summary: An authenticated user can turn crafted chat input or document text into host-command execution through the ChatBI common agent execution tool, exposing datasource credentials and model API keys.
unverified_claims: A referenced advisory is tagged exploit, but this run did not independently establish confirmed exploitation.
qualifying_updates.upstream_routing: keep local security finding; broad product catalog remains upstream

qualifying_updates.summary: The local stdio MCP template tool accepts absolute paths outside configured template roots, allowing a same-user client to infer readable file content through matching attribute fragments; fixed releases are 1.0.10, 1.1.7, 1.2.4, and 1.3.0rc8.
qualifying_updates.upstream_routing: keep local security finding; broad djust and MCP catalog remains upstream

qualifying_updates.summary: A gateway creator can place an arbitrary internal or cloud-metadata URL in OAuth token_url, inducing a credential-bearing POST and limited response reflection in ContextForge MCP Gateway through 1.0.5.
qualifying_updates.upstream_routing: keep local security finding; product catalog remains upstream

qualifying_updates.summary: Prompt-influenced nested CodeMode tool calls can bypass configured tool-call limits and exceed operator controls over costly or side-effecting tools before harness 0.59.0.
qualifying_updates.upstream_routing: keep local security finding; broad Pydantic AI coverage remains upstream

qualifying_updates.summary: The CLI MCP server binds all interfaces without authentication before 4.5.4, allowing LAN or browser-originated tool calls to use the developer's stored access token.
qualifying_updates.upstream_routing: keep local security finding; product catalog remains upstream

qualifying_updates.summary: An authenticated evaluation-job submitter can direct a model URL so the job forwards a tenant model-authentication secret to an attacker listener and reaches internal endpoints.
qualifying_updates.upstream_routing: keep local security finding; general OpenShift AI and evaluation tooling remain upstream

qualifying_updates.summary: A documented Azure deployment can leave the MCP API key empty while exposing the listener publicly, allowing anonymous read/search access to indexed proprietary source and metadata before 1.11.0.
qualifying_updates.upstream_routing: keep local security finding; broad Dynamics 365 and MCP catalog remain upstream

qualifying_updates.summary: Clients sharing an experimental InMemoryTaskStore can list, read, or cancel one another's tasks because task ownership was not tied to the creating session before 1.32.0.
qualifying_updates.upstream_routing: keep local security finding; broad MCP SDK coverage remains upstream
